name: mu-corporate-income-tax
description: Mauritius corporate income tax for accounting years in the 2026/27 income year. Covers the 15 percent rate, the 3 percent export and other reduced rate, bank rates, alternative minimum tax, the 80 percent partial exemption, Corporate Social Responsibility, the Corporate Climate Responsibility levy and its Finance Act 2026 reductions, the company Fair Share Contribution, the domestic minimum top-up tax, the Advance Payment System, losses, returns and penalties. Use for Mauritius company tax, APS statements, CSR, CCR levy, FSC, or company return due dates at the MRA.
